knowledge_package.title: Acoustic Synchronization of Dha (Ge + Na Compound Stroke)
knowledge_package.summary: Bimanual synchronization of the bass Bayan modulation with the treble Dayan rim stroke to produce a singular resonant acoustic timbre.

claims.statement: The flat wrist heel slide on the Bayan (Ge) and the index finger rim strike on the Dayan (Na) must impact within +/- 15ms.
Simultaneous strike generates a composite acoustic spectrum combining 85Hz bass modulation with 440Hz ringing harmonic overtone.

rubric.title: Tabla Dha Timbre & Temporal Synchronization Rubric
rubric.description: Deterministic acoustic scoring of bimanual strike offset, harmonic balance, and wrist dampening.

criteria.name: Bimanual strike temporal offset (< 15ms)
criteria.description: Bayan bass onset and Dayan treble onset align within 15 milliseconds.
criteria.observable_indicator: Delta T between acoustic rise times <= 15ms on waveform envelope.

criteria.name: Bayan wrist modulation & sustain
criteria.description: Left wrist applies sliding pressure on syahi to modulate 85Hz fundamental pitch.
criteria.observable_indicator: Pitch glide visible in 70Hz–110Hz spectrogram band.

criteria.name: Dayan ringing clarity (ring finger damping)
criteria.description: Ring finger rests lightly on sur edge while index finger strikes kinar cleanly.
criteria.observable_indicator: Sustained 440Hz A4 harmonic overtone with Q-factor > 20.

practice_task.title: Execute 4 Balanced Dha Strokes on Sam
practice_task.instructions: Play four consecutive "Dha" strokes at 60 BPM, ensuring simultaneous acoustic contact of both hands and resonant decay.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Dayan-Bayan onset gap was 48ms; heard as disjointed "ta-ge" instead of unified "Dha".
Wrist slide was abrupt, muting resonance after 110ms.
Crisp kinar strike with clear 440Hz resonance.

feedback.summary: Targeted corrective feedback for the next attempt.

items.what_was_observed: Bayan hand made acoustic contact 48ms after Dayan rim hit.
items.what_differed: Bayan hand made acoustic contact 48ms after Dayan rim hit.
items.corrective_advice: Drop both hands as a single mechanical unit. Anticipate the Bayan bass drop slightly before Dayan touch.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Bimanual onset delta measured at 8ms (well within 15ms target window).
Smooth wrist glide created 280ms rich bass decay envelope.
Clean metallic chime with zero unwanted buzz.

lineage.adaptation_notes: Millisecond acoustic onset envelope visualization allowed immediate tactile correction.
